```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(highcharter)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(htmltools)

#   agea     - age of respondent (numeric)
#   ppltrst  - most people can be trusted (0-10)
#   pplfair  - most people try to be fair (0-10)
#   pplhlp   - most people try to be helpful (0-10)
#   trstprl  - trust in country's parliament (0-10)
#   trstlgl  - trust in the legal system (0-10)
#   trstplc  - trust in the police (0-10)
#   trstplt  - trust in politicians (0-10)
#   trstprt  - trust in political parties (0-10)
#   trstep   - trust in the European Parliament (0-10)
#   trstun   - trust in the United Nations (0-10)

data <- readRDS("ess-11-trust-all.rds")

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 14, color = "#1a1a1a")

ess_red <- "#ED3D42"

# Darker shade of red to highlight each country's most common trust score.
darken_hex <- function(hex, factor = 0.8) {
  rgb_vals <- col2rgb(hex) * factor
  rgb(rgb_vals[1], rgb_vals[2], rgb_vals[3], maxColorValue = 255)
}
ess_red_dark <- darken_hex(ess_red, factor = 0.8)

country_names <- c(
  AT = "Austria", BE = "Belgium", BG = "Bulgaria", HR = "Croatia", CY = "Cyprus",
  CZ = "Czechia", EE = "Estonia", FI = "Finland", FR = "France", DE = "Germany",
  GR = "Greece", HU = "Hungary", IS = "Iceland", IE = "Ireland", IL = "Israel",
  IT = "Italy", LV = "Latvia", LT = "Lithuania", ME = "Montenegro",
  NL = "Netherlands", NO = "Norway", PL = "Poland", PT = "Portugal", RS = "Serbia",
  SK = "Slovakia", SI = "Slovenia", ES = "Spain", SE = "Sweden",
  CH = "Switzerland", UA = "Ukraine", GB = "United Kingdom"
)

cntry_codes <- sort(unique(data$cntry))
cntry_labels <- unname(ifelse(cntry_codes %in% names(country_names),
                               country_names[cntry_codes], cntry_codes))
name_order <- order(cntry_labels)
cntry_codes <- cntry_codes[name_order]
cntry_labels <- cntry_labels[name_order]

groups <- c("All", cntry_codes)
group_labels <- c("All", cntry_labels)

ppltrst_by_country <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") data else data |> filter(cntry == g)
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(ppltrst)) |>
    count(ppltrst) |>
    complete(ppltrst = 0:10, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    arrange(ppltrst) |>
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
           percentage_precise = sprintf("%.1f", percentage))
})

avg_scores <- vapply(ppltrst_by_country, function(d) {
  round(weighted.mean(d$ppltrst, w = d$n), 1)
}, numeric(1))

total_n <- vapply(ppltrst_by_country, function(d) sum(d$n), numeric(1))

bar_colors_by_country <- lapply(ppltrst_by_country, function(d) {
  ifelse(d$percentage == max(d$percentage), ess_red_dark, ess_red)
})

pplfair_by_country <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") data else data |> filter(cntry == g)
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(pplfair)) |>
    count(pplfair) |>
    complete(pplfair = 0:10, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    arrange(pplfair) |>
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
           percentage_precise = sprintf("%.1f", percentage))
})

avg_scores_fair <- vapply(pplfair_by_country, function(d) {
  round(weighted.mean(d$pplfair, w = d$n), 1)
}, numeric(1))

total_n_fair <- vapply(pplfair_by_country, function(d) sum(d$n), numeric(1))

bar_colors_by_country_fair <- lapply(pplfair_by_country, function(d) {
  ifelse(d$percentage == max(d$percentage), ess_red_dark, ess_red)
})

pplhlp_by_country <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") data else data |> filter(cntry == g)
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(pplhlp)) |>
    count(pplhlp) |>
    complete(pplhlp = 0:10, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    arrange(pplhlp) |>
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
           percentage_precise = sprintf("%.1f", percentage))
})

avg_scores_help <- vapply(pplhlp_by_country, function(d) {
  round(weighted.mean(d$pplhlp, w = d$n), 1)
}, numeric(1))

total_n_help <- vapply(pplhlp_by_country, function(d) sum(d$n), numeric(1))

bar_colors_by_country_help <- lapply(pplhlp_by_country, function(d) {
  ifelse(d$percentage == max(d$percentage), ess_red_dark, ess_red)
})

trstplt_by_country <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") data else data |> filter(cntry == g)
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(trstplt)) |>
    count(trstplt) |>
    complete(trstplt = 0:10, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    arrange(trstplt) |>
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
           percentage_precise = sprintf("%.1f", percentage))
})

avg_scores_plt <- vapply(trstplt_by_country, function(d) {
  round(weighted.mean(d$trstplt, w = d$n), 1)
}, numeric(1))

total_n_plt <- vapply(trstplt_by_country, function(d) sum(d$n), numeric(1))

bar_colors_by_country_plt <- lapply(trstplt_by_country, function(d) {
  ifelse(d$percentage == max(d$percentage), ess_red_dark, ess_red)
})

trstplc_by_country <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  d <- if (g == "All") data else data |> filter(cntry == g)
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(trstplc)) |>
    count(trstplc) |>
    complete(trstplc = 0:10, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    arrange(trstplc) |>
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
           percentage_precise = sprintf("%.1f", percentage))
})

avg_scores_plc <- vapply(trstplc_by_country, function(d) {
  round(weighted.mean(d$trstplc, w = d$n), 1)
}, numeric(1))

total_n_plc <- vapply(trstplc_by_country, function(d) sum(d$n), numeric(1))

bar_colors_by_country_plc <- lapply(trstplc_by_country, function(d) {
  ifelse(d$percentage == max(d$percentage), ess_red_dark, ess_red)
})

# ISO-3 codes for the choropleth map (Plotly's most reliable location key)
country_iso3 <- c(
  AT = "AUT", BE = "BEL", BG = "BGR", HR = "HRV", CY = "CYP",
  CZ = "CZE", EE = "EST", FI = "FIN", FR = "FRA", DE = "DEU",
  GR = "GRC", HU = "HUN", IS = "ISL", IE = "IRL", IL = "ISR",
  IT = "ITA", LV = "LVA", LT = "LTU", ME = "MNE",
  NL = "NLD", NO = "NOR", PL = "POL", PT = "PRT", RS = "SRB",
  SK = "SVK", SI = "SVN", ES = "ESP", SE = "SWE",
  CH = "CHE", UA = "UKR", GB = "GBR"
)

# Combined trust score per country: unweighted mean of the five per-country
# averages already computed above (ppltrst, pplfair, pplhlp, trstplt, trstplc).
# avg_scores* are indexed in the same order as groups (c("All", cntry_codes)),
# so [-1] drops the "All" row and keeps only the per-country values.
combined_avg_by_country <- data.frame(
  cntry = cntry_codes,
  cntry_label = cntry_labels,
  iso3 = unname(country_iso3[cntry_codes]),
  combined_avg = rowMeans(cbind(
    avg_scores[-1],
    avg_scores_fair[-1],
    avg_scores_help[-1],
    avg_scores_plt[-1],
    avg_scores_plc[-1]
  ))
) |>
  mutate(combined_avg = round(combined_avg, 2))

# Annotation helpers

avg_annotation <- function(avg) {
  list(
    text = paste0("Average trust level: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>", avg, "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

n_annotation <- function(n) {
  list(
    text = paste0("n: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>",
                  formatC(n, big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 0.96, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

avg_annotation_fair <- function(avg) {
  list(
    text = paste0("Average fairness level: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>", avg, "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

avg_annotation_help <- function(avg) {
  list(
    text = paste0("Average helpfulness level: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>", avg, "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

avg_annotation_plt <- function(avg) {
  list(
    text = paste0("Average trust level: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>", avg, "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

avg_annotation_plc <- function(avg) {
  list(
    text = paste0("Average trust level: <span style='color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:700;'>", avg, "</span>"),
    xref = "paper", x = 1, xanchor = "right",
    yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "top",
    align = "right",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")
  )
}

# Pre-compute the full per-country trace + annotation data

build_group_data <- function(by_country, avg_scores, total_n, bar_colors, avg_annotation_fn) {
  lapply(seq_along(groups), function(i) {
    d <- by_country[[i]]
    list(
      x = I(as.character(d[[1]])),
      y = I(d$percentage),
      text = I(ifelse(d$n == 0, "", paste0("<b>", d$percentage_precise, "%</b>"))),
      hovertext = I(paste0("<b>", formatC(d$n, big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b> respondents")),
      marker_color = I(bar_colors[[i]]),
      annotations = list(avg_annotation_fn(avg_scores[i]), n_annotation(total_n[i]))
    )
  })
}

trust_group_data <- build_group_data(ppltrst_by_country, avg_scores, total_n,
                                      bar_colors_by_country, avg_annotation)
fair_group_data <- build_group_data(pplfair_by_country, avg_scores_fair, total_n_fair,
                                     bar_colors_by_country_fair, avg_annotation_fair)
help_group_data <- build_group_data(pplhlp_by_country, avg_scores_help, total_n_help,
                                     bar_colors_by_country_help, avg_annotation_help)
plt_group_data <- build_group_data(trstplt_by_country, avg_scores_plt, total_n_plt,
                                    bar_colors_by_country_plt, avg_annotation_plt)
plc_group_data <- build_group_data(trstplc_by_country, avg_scores_plc, total_n_plc,
                                    bar_colors_by_country_plc, avg_annotation_plc)

filter_js <- paste0(
  "window.essTrustData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(trust_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.essFairData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(fair_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.essHelpData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(help_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.essPltData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(plt_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "window.essPlcData = ", as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(plc_group_data, auto_unbox = TRUE)), ";\n",
  "
function essFindGraphDiv(preferredId, positionIndex) {
  var el = document.getElementById(preferredId);
  if (el && el.data) return el;

  var all = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot'));
  var byId = all.find(function (e) { return e.id && e.id.indexOf(preferredId) !== -1; });
  if (byId) return byId;

  if (all.length > positionIndex) return all[positionIndex];
  return null;
}

function essSetNavbarHeightVar() {
  var navbar = document.querySelector('.navbar');
  var h = navbar ? navbar.offsetHeight : 72;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ess-navbar-height', h + 'px');
}
essSetNavbarHeightVar();
window.addEventListener('resize', essSetNavbarHeightVar);
window.addEventListener('load', essSetNavbarHeightVar);

var ESS_ANIM_OPTS = {
  transition: { duration: 500, easing: 'cubic-in-out' },
  frame: { duration: 500, redraw: false }
};

function essAnimateBars(el, g) {
  if (!g || !el) return;
  Plotly.relayout(el, { annotations: g.annotations });
  Plotly.animate(el, {
    data: [{
      x: g.x, y: g.y, text: g.text, hovertext: g.hovertext,
      marker: { color: g.marker_color }
    }],
    traces: [0]
  }, ESS_ANIM_OPTS);
}

window.essUpdateCountry = function (idx) {
  try {
    var t = window.essTrustData[idx];
    var f = window.essFairData[idx];
    var h = window.essHelpData[idx];
    var p = window.essPltData[idx];
    var c = window.essPlcData[idx];
    var trustEl = essFindGraphDiv('ppltrst-bar', 0);
    var fairEl = essFindGraphDiv('pplfair-bar', 1);
    var helpEl = essFindGraphDiv('pplhlp-bar', 2);
    var pltEl = essFindGraphDiv('trstplt-bar', 3);
    var plcEl = essFindGraphDiv('trstplc-bar', 4);
    console.log('[ess-filter] resolved elements:', trustEl ? trustEl.id : null, fairEl ? fairEl.id : null, helpEl ? helpEl.id : null, pltEl ? pltEl.id : null, plcEl ? plcEl.id : null);

    essAnimateBars(trustEl, t);
    essAnimateBars(fairEl, f);
    essAnimateBars(helpEl, h);
    essAnimateBars(pltEl, p);
    essAnimateBars(plcEl, c);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('ESS country filter update failed:', err);
  }
};

function essInitCountryFilter() {
  var control = document.getElementById('country-filter');
  if (!control || control.getAttribute('data-ess-init') === '1') return;
  control.setAttribute('data-ess-init', '1');

  var valueSpan = control.querySelector('.ess-country-filter-value');
  var menu = control.querySelector('.ess-country-filter-menu');
  var items = menu ? menu.querySelectorAll('.ess-country-option') : [];

  function closeMenu() {
    control.classList.remove('open');
    control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    document.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
  }
  function openMenu() {
    control.classList.add('open');
    control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    document.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);
  }
  function onDocClick(e) {
    if (!control.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (li) {
    li.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var idx = parseInt(li.getAttribute('data-index'), 10);
      valueSpan.textContent = li.textContent;
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(items, function (o) { o.classList.remove('active'); });
      li.classList.add('active');
      console.log('[ess-filter] country selected, index', idx);
      window.essUpdateCountry(idx);
      closeMenu();
    });
  });

  control.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
  });
  control.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      closeMenu();
    }
  });
}
essInitCountryFilter();

console.log('[ess-filter] country-filter.js loaded OK,', window.essTrustData.length, 'countries available.');
console.log('[ess-filter] plotly divs on page:', Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot')).map(function (e) { return e.id; }));
"
)
writeLines(filter_js, "country-filter.js")

#| label: ppltrst-bar
initial <- ppltrst_by_country[[1]]

plot_ly(elementId = "ppltrst-bar") |>
  add_trace(
    data = initial,
    x = ~factor(ppltrst, levels = 0:10),
    y = ~percentage,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = bar_colors_by_country[[1]]),
    text = ~ifelse(n == 0, "", paste0("<b>", percentage_precise, "%</b>")),
    textposition = "outside",
    textfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 16, color = "#1a1a1a"),
    hovertext = ~paste0("<b>", formatC(n, big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b> respondents"),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Most People Can Be Trusted</b> ",
        "<span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(0: You can't be too careful, 10: Most people can be trusted)</span>"
      ),
      font = title_font,
      x = 0
    ),
    annotations = list(avg_annotation(avg_scores[1]), n_annotation(total_n[1])),
    margin = list(t = 100, pad = 8),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hovermode = "x",
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#6B1B1E",
      bordercolor = "#6B1B1E",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Trust level (0 - 10)",
                              font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")),
                 showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 type = "category",
                 categoryorder = "array",
                 categoryarray = as.character(0:10),
                 tickmode = "array",
                 tickvals = as.character(0:10),
                 ticktext = as.character(0:10),
                 fixedrange = TRUE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12)),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 ticksuffix = "%",
                 range = c(0, 50),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  add_trace(
    data = initial_help,
    x = ~factor(pplhlp, levels = 0:10),
    y = ~percentage,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = bar_colors_by_country_help[[1]]),
    text = ~ifelse(n == 0, "", paste0("<b>", percentage_precise, "%</b>")),
    textposition = "outside",
    textfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 16, color = "#1a1a1a"),
    hovertext = ~paste0("<b>", formatC(n, big.mark = " ", format = "d"), "</b> respondents"),
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>Most People Try to Be Helpful</b> ",
        "<span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(0: People mostly look out for themselves, 10: People mostly try to be helpful)</span>"
      ),
      font = title_font,
      x = 0
    ),
    annotations = list(avg_annotation_help(avg_scores_help[1]), n_annotation(total_n_help[1])),
    margin = list(t = 100, pad = 8),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hovermode = "x",
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#6B1B1E",
      bordercolor = "#6B1B1E",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = list(text = "Helpfulness level (0 - 10)",
                              font = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#555555")),
                 showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE,
                 type = "category",
                 categoryorder = "array",
                 categoryarray = as.character(0:10),
                 tickmode = "array",
                 tickvals = as.character(0:10),
                 ticktext = as.character(0:10),
                 fixedrange = TRUE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12)),
    yaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE, showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE, tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 ticksuffix = "%",
                 range = c(0, 50),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white"
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Row {height="550px"}

```{r}
#| label: trust-map-highcharts
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Prepare data for Highcharts
map_data <- combined_avg_by_country |>
  mutate(
    name = cntry_label,
    value = combined_avg
  )

# Create Highcharts map with custom styling
hcmap(
  map = "custom/europe",
  data = map_data,
  value = "value",
  joinBy = "name",
  name = "Combined Trust Score",
  dataLabels = list(enabled = FALSE)
) |>
  hc_title(
    text = "<b>Combined Average by Country</b> <span style='color:#666666;font-weight:400;'>(average across all five trust measures, 0 - 10)</span>",
    align = "left",
    useHTML = TRUE,
    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Outfit, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "14px",
      color = "#1a1a1a"
    )
  ) |>
  hc_colorAxis(
    min = min(map_data$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(map_data$value, na.rm = TRUE),
    stops = color_stops(colors = c("#FCE4E4", "#ED3D42", "#6B1B1E")),
    nullColor = "#f7f7f7"
  ) |>
  hc_tooltip(
    useHTML = TRUE,
    headerFormat = "",
    formatter = JS("function() {
      var val = this.point.value;
      if (val === undefined || val === null) {
        return '<b>' + this.point.name + '</b><br/>No data';
      } else {
        return '<b>' + this.point.name + '</b><br/>Combined trust: <b>' + val.toFixed(1) + '</b>';
      }
    }")
  ) |>
  hc_plotOptions(
    series = list(
      nullInteraction = TRUE, # lets countries with no data still respond to hover/tooltip
      borderColor = "#cccccc",
      borderWidth = 0.5,
      states = list(
        hover = list(
          borderColor = "#1a1a1a",
          borderWidth = 2
        )
      )
    )
  ) |>
  hc_chart(
    backgroundColor = "white",
    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Inter, sans-serif"
    )
  ) |>
  hc_legend(
    enabled = TRUE,
    title = list(text = "Combined Trust Score"),
    layout = "vertical",
    align = "right",
    verticalAlign = "middle",
    itemStyle = list(
      fontFamily = "Inter, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "12px",
      color = "#555555"
    )
  ) |>
  hc_mapNavigation(
    enabled = FALSE
  )
```
